title: TD2 Comms: Manhunt - Keener's Legacy
summary: A collection of 20 comms from The Division universe, scraped from the Fandom wiki hub page. 20 entries include full audio transcripts; 0 have known map locations.

claims.text: Comm "Test Results": Lori Baker and a nurse discuss how to handle the influx of patients at a CERA hospital
Comm "Not This Time": Lori Baker and a nurse discuss how to handle weak and vulnerable patients at a CERA hospital
Comm "Elevator Pitch": Keener convinces Lori Baker to help him eradicate the weak
Comm "Callsigns": Keener convinces Lori Baker to help him bring Carter Leroux back to good health
Comm "Regaining Control": Tegan Silver opposes the JTF's decision to pull out from the Dark Zone
Comm "Encrypted ECHOs": Tegan Silver is briefed on Aaron Keener and tasked with reconstructing his encrypted ECHOs
Comm "Luna's Offer": Tegan Silver contacts Aaron Keener and offers to feed him information on Division operations
Comm "The Consulate": Tegan Silver informs Keener an impending Division assault at the Russian Consulate
Comm "Leroux's Psyche Eval": Elijah Le and another Division recruiter discuss the results of Carter Leroux's psyche evaluation
Comm "Taking Control": Elijah Le agrees to support the LMB after the JTF's withdrawal from the Dark Zone
Comm "Sorry About Bliss": Keener convinces Elijah Le to join him after the death of Charles Bliss
Comm "Power Play": Elijah Le and Carter Leroux disagree over who will take control after Keener's death
Comm "Emergency Recruitment": Smokejumper Jason Barnes is recruited and activated to coordinate fire defense systems in New York
Comm "Checking Out": Jason Barnes checks himself out of hospital after suffering from smoke inhalation injury
Comm "Nature's Decision": Barnes makes a fatalistic declaration for the Division after checking himself out of hospital
Comm "Changing Course": Keener manipulates Jason Barnes into
Comm "SetBacks": Hornet vows to fulfill Keener's Legacy after recovering from his injuries in Russian Consulate
Comm "Eclipse": Hornet demonstrates the power of the Eclipse Virus to get the Outcasts on his side
Comm "Dying Breath": Hornet and an unknown leader of another rogue cell make delivery arrangements for the Eclipse Virus
Comm "Back From The Dead": Schaeffer fails to recruit Hornet to the Black Tusk after the death of Aaron Keener
